subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: Anonymous Whistleblowing
description: A micro-lesson that makes Anonymous Whistleblowing usable.

hook.text: SecureDrop lets anyone submit documents to journalists anonymously. No name. No email. No trace.

buildup.text: Built on Tor, SecureDrop is used by the Washington Post, New York Times, and dozens of newsrooms worldwide.

discovery.text: Whistleblowers use it to share evidence of corruption, fraud, and abuse without revealing their identity.

twist.text: Even secure channels can fail if whistleblowers make mistakes — like printing documents on a traceable printer.

climax.text: Anonymous channels protect sources. But anonymity requires perfect discipline — one mistake can be fatal.

punchline.text: Speak truth safely. One mistake undoes it all.
